summary: Decode aligned application body readbacks with a bulk Pod copy instead of a per-record iterator; keep the unaligned fallback.
regressions: Native tests compare exact aligned/unaligned bit patterns, empty data, truncated lengths and source guards.
An isolated noalias-disabled debug microbenchmark of 63005 32-byte records measures about 1.32 ms per legacy decode versus 0.027 ms for the aligned bulk path; this is not the whole frame time.
differences: No upload, shader, arithmetic, readback frequency or public layout changes. The checked native body prefix still excludes capacity guards.
